title: ClamantisFi
tagline: Decentralized perpetuals and options trading on Citrea Testnet with BTC and ETH support
description:
Clamantis is a decentralized trading frontend for Perpetual Futures and European-style Options built specifically for the Citrea Testnet. The platform allows users to trade popular assets like BTC, ETH, using USDC as collateral.

https://github.com/clamantisfi

Key Features:
High-Leverage Perpetual Futures: Users can open Long or Short positions with up to 50x leverage, utilizing Pyth Network oracles for real-time pricing and P&L tracking.

Cash-Settled Options: The platform supports buying and selling Call & Put options with multiple expiration periods (24h, 7d, 30d). SeTrade BTC and ETH on chain with clamantis. Using pyth to fetch data of the btc and eth and update on the oracle of citrea testnet. You can LONG and SHORT PERPs on Chain with full transparency and security of defittlement is automatic at expiry using oracle prices.

Account Management: Users deposit/withdraw MockUSDC and monitor their balances, positions, and comprehensive transaction history in real-time.
how_its_made:
I created it using pyth hermes api, onchain orcale for citrea network which pushes update from pyth. 

Oracles: Pyth Network is integrated to provide reliable, real-time price feeds for all supported assets (BTC, ETH), which is crucial for trade execution, position liquidation, and options settlement.

Frontend Design: The User Interface is designed to be Responsive (desktop and mobile) and includes a TradingView integration for professional technical analysis.
